body: These are positions on long shots that are likely to go up some but not win in the end...hence the auto sell orders.

author: John Larson
body: Hi Stu, I've started placing positions and setting automatic sell orders when it gets 150% profit against my initial position. This is conservative but is it a smart strategy?

author: Stu Burguiere
body: Nothing wrong with that approach. I think as you go, you can tailor it a bit to the types of contracts and opinions you have.  But, if you’re consistently grabbing 50% gains, it’s a great place to be (obviously!)
